{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /root/.claude/skills/brand-guidelines\n\n# Anthropic Brand Styling\r\n\r\n## Overview\r\n\r\nTo access Anthropic's official brand identity and style resources, use this skill.\r\n\r\n**Keywords**: branding, corporate identity, visual identity, post-processing, styling, brand colors, typography, Anthropic brand, visual formatting, visual design\r\n\r\n## Brand Guidelines\r\n\r\n### Colors\r\n\r\n**Main Colors:**\r\n\r\n- Dark: `#141413` - Primary text and dark backgrounds\r\n- Light: `#faf9f5` - Light backgrounds and text on dark\r\n- Mid Gray: `#b0aea5` - Secondary elements\r\n- Light Gray: `#e8e6dc` - Subtle backgrounds\r\n\r\n**Accent Colors:**\r\n\r\n- Orange: `#d97757` - Primary accent\r\n- Blue: `#6a9bcc` - Secondary accent\r\n- Green: `#788c5d` - Tertiary accent\r\n\r\n### Typography\r\n\r\n- **Headings**: Poppins (with Arial fallback)\r\n- **Body Text**: Lora (with Georgia fallback)\r\n- **Note**: Fonts should be pre-installed in your environment for best results\r\n\r\n## Features\r\n\r\n### Smart Font Application\r\n\r\n- Applies Poppins font to headings (24pt and larger)\r\n- Applies Lora font to body text\r\n- Automatically falls back to Arial/Georgia if custom fonts unavailable\r\n- Preserves readability across all systems\r\n\r\n### Text Styling\r\n\r\n- Headings (24pt+): Poppins font\r\n- Body text: Lora font\r\n- Smart color selection based on background\r\n- Preserves text hierarchy and formatting\r\n\r\n### Shape and Accent Colors\r\n\r\n- Non-text shapes use accent colors\r\n- Cycles through orange, blue, and green accents\r\n- Maintains visual interest while staying on-brand\r\n\r\n## Technical Details\r\n\r\n### Font Management\r\n\r\n- Uses system-installed Poppins and Lora fonts when available\r\n- Provides automatic fallback to Arial (headings) and Georgia (body)\r\n- No font installation required - works with existing system fonts\r\n- For best results, pre-install Poppins and Lora fonts in your environment\r\n\r\n### Color Application\r\n\r\n- Uses RGB color values for precise brand matching\r\n- Applied via python-pptx's RGBColor class\r\n- Maintains color fidelity across different systems"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"725ac319-46ad-455c-a3d2-2dcaac0d5839","uuid":"64b0cf44-8e5b-4f98-bb64-7c4ea7be3fed","timestamp":"2026-03-20T01:00:53.627Z","isSynthetic":true}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-4-6","id":"msg_01YXXi8PVh7tAQCeCGQrkosa","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01BfPWgUbhj5RSxfM842MvQH","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/root/generate_helio.py","content":"\"\"\"\nHelio — Anthropic branded logo sheet generator\nBrand tokens:\n  Identity Light   #faf9f5   (background)\n  Corporate Dark   #141413   (primary wordmark + symbol)\n  Primary Accent   #d97757   (one highlight element)\n  Heading font     Poppins\n\"\"\"\n\nimport math\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont\n\n# ── Brand tokens ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nBG       = (250, 249, 245)   # #faf9f5  Identity Light\nDARK     = ( 20,  20,  19)   # #141413  Corporate Dark\nACCENT   = (217, 119,  87)   # #d97757  Primary Accent\nMID_GRAY = (176, 174, 165)   # #b0aea5  Secondary / utility\nLT_GRAY  = (232, 230, 220)   # #e8e6dc  Subtle rule\n\n# ── Canvas ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nW, H = 1400, 900\nimg  = Image.new(\"RGB\", (W, H), BG)\ndraw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)\n\n# ── Fonts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nPOPPINS_REG   = \"/usr/share/fonts/truetype/poppins/Poppins-Regular.ttf\"\nPOPPINS_LIGHT = \"/usr/share/fonts/truetype/poppins/Poppins-Light.ttf\"\nFALLBACK      = \"/usr/share/fonts/truetype/open-sans/OpenSans-Light.ttf\"\n\ndef load(path, size):\n    try:\n        return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)\n    except Exception:\n        return ImageFont.truetype(FALLBACK, size)\n\nf_wordmark  = load(POPPINS_LIGHT,  112)   # main HELIO wordmark\nf_supertag  = load(POPPINS_LIGHT,   18)   # top-left product tag\nf_swatchlbl = load(POPPINS_LIGHT,   13)   # swatch hex labels\n\n# ── Helper ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\ndef text_size(draw, text, font):\n    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)\n    return bb[2] - bb[0], bb[3] - bb[1]\n\ndef draw_text_centered(draw, y, text, font, color):\n    w, h = text_size(draw, text, font)\n    draw.text(((W - w) / 2, y), text, font=font, fill=color)\n    return h\n\n# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n#  TOP-LEFT product label\n# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\ndraw.text((60, 52), \"HELIO\", font=f_supertag, fill=MID_GRAY)\ndraw.text((60, 76), \"Identity System  ·  2026\", font=f_supertag, fill=MID_GRAY)\n\n# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n#  SUN EMBLEM  (centered around cx, cy)\n#  Thin outer ring + 8 radiating tick marks + solid inner disc\n# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\ncx, cy = W // 2, 310\nR_OUTER    = 78    # radius of the circle ring\nR_INNER    = 66    # inner edge of tick gaps\nTICK_LEN   = 10    # tick mark length (R_OUTER → R_OUTER + TICK_LEN)\nRING_W     = 2     # stroke width\nTICK_W     = 2\nDISC_R     = 7     # center accent disc radius\n\n# Outer ring\ndraw.ellipse(\n    [cx - R_OUTER, cy - R_OUTER, cx + R_OUTER, cy + R_OUTER],\n    outline=DARK, width=RING_W\n)\n\n# 8 radiating tick marks at 45° intervals\nfor i in range(8):\n    angle = math.radians(i * 45)\n    x0 = cx + math.cos(angle) * R_OUTER\n    y0 = cy + math.sin(angle) * R_OUTER\n    x1 = cx + math.cos(angle) * (R_OUTER + TICK_LEN)\n    y1 = cy + math.sin(angle) * (R_OUTER + TICK_LEN)\n    draw.line([x0, y0, x1, y1], fill=DARK, width=TICK_W)\n\n# ── Primary Accent ── center disc (one highlight detail)\ndraw.ellipse(\n    [cx - DISC_R, cy - DISC_R, cx + DISC_R, cy + DISC_R],\n    fill=ACCENT\n)\n\n# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n#  WORDMARK  \"HELIO\"  — widely letter-spaced feel via manual kerning\n# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nWORDMARK_Y = 430\nLETTER_SPACING = 14   # extra pixels between characters\n\nletters = \"HELIO\"\n# Measure total width with spacing\ntotal_w = 0\nletter_widths = []\nfor ch in letters:\n    lw, _ = text_size(draw, ch, f_wordmark)\n    letter_widths.append(lw)\n    total_w += lw\ntotal_w += LETTER_SPACING * (len(letters) - 1)\n\nx = (W - total_w) / 2\nfor i, ch in enumerate(letters):\n    draw.text((x, WORDMARK_Y), ch, font=f_wordmark, fill=DARK)\n    x += letter_widths[i] + LETTER_SPACING\n\n# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n#  THIN HORIZONTAL RULE below wordmark  (subtle light-gray)\n# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nRULE_Y   = WORDMARK_Y + 130\nRULE_LEN = 260\nrule_x0  = (W - RULE_LEN) // 2\ndraw.line([(rule_x0, RULE_Y), (rule_x0 + RULE_LEN, RULE_Y)],\n          fill=LT_GRAY, width=1)\n\n# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n#  PRODUCT DESCRIPTOR  (small subtitle)\n# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nf_desc = load(POPPINS_LIGHT, 16)\nDESC_Y = RULE_Y + 18\ndraw_text_centered(draw, DESC_Y, \"Internal Platform  ·  Anthropic\", f_desc, MID_GRAY)\n\n# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n#  COLOUR SWATCHES  — bottom section\n# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nSWATCH_Y      = 740\nSWATCH_W      = 110\nSWATCH_H      = 36\nSWATCH_GAP    = 28\nswatch_data = [\n    (BG,       \"#faf9f5\",  \"Identity Light\",  DARK),\n    (DARK,     \"#141413\",  \"Corporate Dark\",  BG),\n    (ACCENT,   \"#d97757\",  \"Primary Accent\",  BG),\n    (LT_GRAY,  \"#e8e6dc\",  \"Light Gray\",      DARK),\n    (MID_GRAY, \"#b0aea5\",  \"Mid Gray\",        DARK),\n]\n\ntotal_swatch_w = len(swatch_data) * SWATCH_W + (len(swatch_data) - 1) * SWATCH_GAP\nsx = (W - total_swatch_w) // 2\n\nfor color, hex_val, label, text_c in swatch_data:\n    # Swatch rectangle\n    draw.rectangle([sx, SWATCH_Y, sx + SWATCH_W, SWATCH_Y + SWATCH_H],\n                   fill=color, outline=LT_GRAY if color == BG else None, width=1)\n    # Hex label below\n    lw, _ = text_size(draw, hex_val, f_swatchlbl)\n    draw.text((sx + (SWATCH_W - lw) / 2, SWATCH_Y + SWATCH_H + 8),\n              hex_val, font=f_swatchlbl, fill=MID_GRAY)\n    # Name label below hex\n    nlw, _ = text_size(draw, label, f_swatchlbl)\n    draw.text((sx + (SWATCH_W - nlw) / 2, SWATCH_Y + SWATCH_H + 24),\n              label, font=f_swatchlbl, fill=MID_GRAY)\n    sx += SWATCH_W + SWATCH_GAP\n\n# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n#  Bottom hairline rule  (full width, very faint)\n# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\ndraw.line([(60, H - 44), (W - 60, H - 44)], fill=LT_GRAY, width=1)\ndraw.text((60, H - 36),\n          \"© Anthropic  ·  Confidential — Internal Use Only\",\n          font=f_swatchlbl, fill=MID_GRAY)\n\n# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n#  Save\n# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nout_path = \"/root/anthropic_branded_artifact.png\"\nimg.save(out_path, \"PNG\", dpi=(144, 144))\nprint(f\"Saved → {out_path}  ({W}×{H}px)\")\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":666,"cache_read_input_tokens":17343,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":666,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"725ac319-46ad-455c-a3d2-2dcaac0d5839","uuid":"80ed7291-606f-4f16-b674-74ae314b95ad"}

extra pixels between characters\n\nletters = \"HELIO\"\n# Measure total width with spacing\ntotal_w = 0\nletter_widths = []\nfor ch in letters:\n    lw, _ = text_size(draw, ch, f_wordmark)\n    letter_widths.append(lw)\n    total_w += lw\ntotal_w += LETTER_SPACING * (len(letters) - 1)\n\nx = (W - total_w) / 2\nfor i, ch in enumerate(letters):\n    draw.text((x, WORDMARK_Y), ch, font=f_wordmark, fill=DARK)\n    x += letter_widths[i] + LETTER_SPACING\n\n# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n#  THIN HORIZONTAL RULE below wordmark  (subtle light-gray)\n# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nRULE_Y   = WORDMARK_Y + 130\nRULE_LEN = 260\nrule_x0  = (W - RULE_LEN) // 2\ndraw.line([(rule_x0, RULE_Y), (rule_x0 + RULE_LEN, RULE_Y)],\n          fill=LT_GRAY, width=1)\n\n# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n#  PRODUCT DESCRIPTOR  (small subtitle)\n# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nf_desc = load(POPPINS_LIGHT, 16)\nDESC_Y = RULE_Y + 18\ndraw_text_centered(draw, DESC_Y, \"Internal Platform  ·  Anthropic\", f_desc, MID_GRAY)\n\n# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n#  COLOUR SWATCHES  — bottom section\n# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nSWATCH_Y      = 740\nSWATCH_W      = 110\nSWATCH_H      = 36\nSWATCH_GAP    = 28\nswatch_data = [\n    (BG,       \"#faf9f5\",  \"Identity Light\",  DARK),\n    (DARK,     \"#141413\",  \"Corporate Dark\",  BG),\n    (ACCENT,   \"#d97757\",  \"Primary Accent\",  BG),\n    (LT_GRAY,  \"#e8e6dc\",  \"Light Gray\",      DARK),\n    (MID_GRAY, \"#b0aea5\",  \"Mid Gray\",        DARK),\n]\n\ntotal_swatch_w = len(swatch_data) * SWATCH_W + (len(swatch_data) - 1) * SWATCH_GAP\nsx = (W - total_swatch_w) // 2\n\nfor color, hex_val, label, text_c in swatch_data:\n    # Swatch rectangle\n    draw.rectangle([sx, SWATCH_Y, sx + SWATCH_W, SWATCH_Y + SWATCH_H],\n                   fill=color, outline=LT_GRAY if color == BG else None, width=1)\n    # Hex label below\n    lw, _ = text_size(draw, hex_val, f_swatchlbl)\n    draw.text((sx + (SWATCH_W - lw) / 2, SWATCH_Y + SWATCH_H + 8),\n              hex_val, font=f_swatchlbl, fill=MID_GRAY)\n    # Name label below hex\n    nlw, _ = text_size(draw, label, f_swatchlbl)\n    draw.text((sx + (SWATCH_W - nlw) / 2, SWATCH_Y + SWATCH_H + 24),\n              label, font=f_swatchlbl, fill=MID_GRAY)\n    sx += SWATCH_W + SWATCH_GAP\n\n# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n#  Bottom hairline rule  (full width, very faint)\n# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\ndraw.line([(60, H - 44), (W - 60, H - 44)], fill=LT_GRAY, width=1)\ndraw.text((60, H - 36),\n          \"© Anthropic  ·  Confidential — Internal Use Only\",\n          font=f_swatchlbl, fill=MID_GRAY)\n\n# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n#  Save\n# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nout_path = \"/root/anthropic_branded_artifact.png\"\nimg.save(out_path, \"PNG\", dpi=(144, 144))\nprint(f\"Saved → {out_path}  ({W}×{H}px)\")\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null}}
